name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical duration for a tub-to-shower conversion project ranges from three to five days, depending on the scope and complexity. This timeframe covers demolition, plumbing adjustments, installation of the shower pan, wall materials, and new fixtures. Factors that can affect the timeline include unexpected structural issues, custom material orders, or extensive tile work. A smooth project relies on clear planning and efficient material delivery.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion typically takes three to five days, but complexity and custom features can extend this timeline.
